def f(g):
    allc=[(v,C) for v in sorted(set(x for r in g for x in r)) for C in comps(g,v)]
    by=defaultdict(list)
    for v,C in allc: by[sign(C)].append((v,C))

    el=[]
    for s,M in by.items():
        if len(M)!=2: continue
        c_ok=all(len(comps(g,v))>=2 or (C and len(C)==1) for v,C in M)
        same_color = M[0][0]==M[1][0]
        if c_ok and (len(M[0])==1 == same_color or len(M[0])>=2):
            el.append(s,M)
    grp=max(el,key=lambda t: sum(len(C) for _,C in t[1]))
    (vA,CA),(vB,CB)=grp
    cc=[(len(C),C,v) for v,C in allc if len(comps(g,v))==1]
    tc=max(cc)[1]; tcol=max(cc)[2]
    da=mindist(CA,tc); db=mindist(CB,tc)
    far=CA if da>=db else CB
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for a,b in far: res[a][b]=tcol
    return res
